name: Mikhail Valente
original_name: ミハイル・ヴァレンテ
source:
Mikhail is one of the four Valente's brothers, a well-known and noble family in the makai, which controls the element of fire. He doesn't talk a lot and acts indifferent towards Yuri.
Unlike his brothers, he can control darkness.
